# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 19 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Seth and Eve Reach Paradise's Gate

---

**1** Seth and Eve arrived at the gate of paradise. Michael the archangel was standing there, guarding it.

**2** Seth begged Michael for the oil of mercy: 'Please give me the oil of mercy so I can anoint my father Adam — he is sick and dying.'

**3** Michael answered Seth: 'Seth, I tell you honestly — I cannot give you what you are asking for. It is not appointed for you in this generation.'

**4** 'But when five thousand five hundred years have passed, the Son of God — the most loving Christ — will come down to earth and raise the body of Adam, and with him the bodies of the dead.'

**5** 'Then the Son of God will be baptized in the Jordan, and when he comes out of the water, he will anoint all who believe in him with the oil of mercy. This oil of mercy will be for all those raised from the dead in his generation.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
